items.title: Ducommun (DCO) After The PAC 3 Contract Win, Does The Undervalued Case Still Hold
items.summary: Contract win puts Ducommun in focus Ducommun (DCO) just announced a new agreement from Simmonds Precision Products worth over US$35 million to supply electronic assemblies for the Lockheed Martin PAC-3 missile family, extending its existing PAC-3 involvement. Investors have seen a sharp run in Ducommun already this year, with a year to date share price return of 71.95% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 77.24%. items.title: What Could Surprise RKLB Stock Investors On The Upside?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) booked $0.8 billion of revenue over the last twelve months. The market values it at $45.3 billion. That price appears to assume something large is still ahead. Two things must both be true for it to pay off. It has to work. It has to be big enough to matter. So what has not flown yet.

items.title: US Running Low on the 2 Weapons It Would Need Most
items.summary: A defense analyst warned that China may be watching gleefully as the Pentagon scrambles to restock two weapons classes critical to any future great-power fight. Four defense contractors sit at the center of a procurement surge that may arrive too slowly to matter.
